newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 69 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 69 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated February 14 to commercial banks worth 69 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 67 billion pounds at 13-percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
Last week, the bank sold 60-day CDs worth 73 billion pounds at 13 percent and 45-day CDs worth 11 billion pounds at 12.25 percent.
